footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net income: includes $8.2M from discontinued operations.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 31.2% to $32.2M in 2025. Gross margin was 49.6%, versus 2.5% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $3.4M from $15.7M.
Net income was $5.1M, or $0.22 per share, after a $13.6M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was −$6.6M and free cash flow −$6.7M, versus −$336K.
